Harness 网页 UI 独立壁纸背景插件：三种来源，包括内置壁纸、自定义上传和 Wallpaper Engine 库（只读）。支持图片、视频和场景预览渲染，还可以调整叠加、模糊、亮度和安全缩放。
# dsh-wallpaper-bg
> v0.5.18 · MIT License
English | 中文
A static two-half plugin that puts an **independent animated wallpaper layer** under the DeepSeek Ha
rness (DSH) interface — both the browser UI (`dsh web`) and the 0.2 **desktop app** (0.2.1 verified)
. Install it with one command (or just the package name in the desktop app's plugin page) and the wh
ole interface sits on a moving wallpaper. The background layer is fully independent from the desktop
Wallpaper Engine: changing wallpapers inside DSH never touches your desktop wallpaper, and vice ver
llpaper Engine: changing wallpapers inside DSH never touches your desktop wallpaper, and vice versa.
## Features
- **Three wallpaper sources**: 10 built-in high-res Unsplash images (grid thumbnails and 1920w backg
rounds ship with the package, so they work offline); custom uploads (images / videos, stored in Inde
xedDB); and read-only access to your locally installed **Wallpaper Engine** library (the companion `
dsh-wallpaper-engine-api` plugin serves the API and the main plugin discovers its port), filtered by

the real Steam subscription list.
- **Playback queue** per source: drag wallpapers into the queue a
nd loop-play them at 1–10 minutes per item, with drag-to-reorder, click-to-jump and localStorage per

sistence. The queue is sticky at the top of its tab.
- **Four render modes**: static images (cover-f
it), videos (`<video object-fit: cover>`, GPU compositing), scene wallpapers (WE's own workshop prev

iew `preview.gif` / `preview.jpg`), and web wallpapers (native iframe rendering of `index.html`).
-
**Four adjustments**: light fog / dark overlay (auto-switching with the DSH theme), background blur

(0–20px), background brightness (50–150%), safe zoom (0–10% to crop edge letterboxing).
- **Unified
azure × rose palette** across theme colors, translucent surfaces, buttons, text, links, gradient sli
ders, the sidebar logo, gradient scrollbars and user bubbles — shared by `dsh web` and the desktop a
pp, including the title bar. Switch back to the original monochrome look under Settings → **General

→ Appearance → Theme palette** ("Classic"); the choice persists.
- **Native background switch** on t
he main conversation page: clears the fog / overlay and the translucent page surfaces in one click,

while the composer and dialogs keep their readable surfaces.
- **Sync desktop wallpaper**: read-only
follow of the current desktop wallpaper (30 s polling, immediate on tab focus), rendered by type, w
ith automatic multi-monitor resolution and a monitor picker. It never changes your desktop wallpaper

and never samples the screen.
- **Black-flash-free switching** with next-item warm-up: wallpaper ch
anges cross-fade two stacked layers over ~0.42 s, and the next queue item is preloaded while the cur

rent one plays.

## Installation
### Prerequisites
- **DeepSeek Harness desktop app (0.2 preview or later; 0.2.1 verified)** — the app bundles its own

Node.js / pnpm runtime, so nothing else is needed;
- **or a CLI install** (`dsh web`) with Node.js ≥

20 (`node -v`) and a working DeepSeek Harness;
- the optional WE library source adds its own requir
ements (Windows, a local Wallpaper Engine install, and the `dsh-wallpaper-engine-api` companion plug
in — one command, no clone / `npm install` / `.bat` / autostart) — see WE library service.
### Desktop app (no command line)

1. Open **Settings → Plugins** (设置 → 插件) and type `dsh-wallpaper-bg` into the install box;
2. Confir

m, and restart the app (or reload the window) when it asks;
3. Open **Settings → Wallpaper** (设置 → 壁
纸) and pick a wallpaper.

(or `--profile desktop`).
### Optional: WE library source (one command)
To use the **WE 壁纸库** tab, install the companion plugin too (Windows + a local Wallpaper Engine inst

It serves a read-only WE API on `127.0.0.1:8088` and follows the DSH lifecycle; the main plugin disc
overs the actual port through a same-origin status route. No repository clone, `npm install`, `.bat`
launcher, or login autostart. The old `wallpaper-engine-api/` folder stays for manual installs; new
users just install the plugin.
### Upgrading
`dsh plugin … add` forwards to `pnpm add`, which keeps the range already recorded in the manifest —
re-running the install command on an existing install changes nothing. Ask for a version explicitly:

## Quick start
[代码示例省略，未执行]

1. Open **Settings → Wallpaper** (设置 → 壁纸).
2. Pick a source tab — 内置壁纸 / 自定义上传 / WE 壁纸库 — and click

a wallpaper to apply it; the background only changes on an explicit selection.
3. Drag wallpapers i
nto the queue to loop-play them, and use the sliders for fog / overlay, blur (0–20px), brightness (5

0–150%) and safe zoom (0–10%).
4. (Optional) Toggle **同步桌面壁纸** to read-only follow the desktop wallp
aper, or flip **Native background** in the main conversation header to reveal the wallpaper complete
r, or flip **Native background** in the main conversation header to reveal the wallpaper completely.
